# Frozen public API contract for the crdt, backend, and protocol packages.
# Format: <package> <kind> <qualified-name> <shape>
# Member names retain their owner; a lowercase owner marks an unreachable internal type.
# Shapes record parameter and result TYPES only — parameter names are omitted because
# renaming one breaks no caller, and including them would fill the diff with changes that
# carry no compatibility meaning. A name-only contract previously passed unchanged while
# Doc.GetMap narrowed its result and NewDoc dropped a parameter; both are breaking and both
# were invisible. Regenerate deliberately in the same reviewed change as the API decision.
backend method Fence.Clustered () bool
